area: sqlite-wal effect transition replay and recovery
risk_before: signed terminal transition intents were bound to prepared row evidence and ledger heads, but not to a durable per-ledger instance identity
changes: added ledger_identity table with generated lowercase sha256 ledger_instance_id
pending-effect report v3 exposes verified ledger_instance_id
transition intent payload/signing input v2 binds ledger_instance_id
effect_transitions rows store and hash-bind ledger_instance_id
read-only snapshot verifier rejects ledger-instance mismatches and duplicate transition intent ids
mutable reload checks transition ledger_instance_id against ledger_identity
